implementation.proposalParent: New request, routing and proposal-send RPCs fail closed on the effective proposal archetype parent; creator deadline remains a separate child rule and urgent-request behavior remains separate.
implementation.providerReadiness: Routing and new send recheck _provider_is_live, active service, category/doc eligibility, paused state, location and event-window conflicts; routing retains its service-role-only privilege.
implementation.requestIntake: Private recursive SchemaField validation checks nested required/object values, scalar and array item types/enums, numeric and string bounds, array bounds/uniqueness, reserved brief/package_id/deliver_by, the minimum brief, unknown values and existing contact screening.
implementation.existingWork: The route stays unchanged for compose, request creation is extracted to its owned host, and existing proposal view/cancel/payment/delivery/refund/expiry functions are not redefined by this stage.
